name: Big Mac Salad Bowl (Cheeseburger in a Bowl)
why: Deconstructed Big Mac / cheeseburger salad bowl: browned ground beef over shredded lettuce with cheddar, pickles, onion, and a ketchup-mayo-relish special sauce - structurally low-carb (no bun, rice, or pasta). Published 491 cal / 9g carbs / 33g protein sits mid-band with a huge carb margin and clears the 25g+ protein identity comfortably. FULLY board-mapped, zero unmapped flags. Distinct from cheeseburger-pasta and cheeseburger-rice-bowls (both are cooked starch skillets); no Big Mac / cheeseburger-salad bowl exists in the beef catalog. Beef browns in one skillet, components weigh-and-divide across 14 servings like the catalog's burrito bowls.
